evals.prompt: Design a financial analytics dashboard and mobile companion spec with DESIGN.md tokens.
evals.expected_output: Calibrate high density and appropriate variance, select a platform design system, write semantic tokens to DESIGN.md, apply nested border-radius math, address phone/tablet orientations, and reject unearned tropes.
expectations: Calibrates Density and Variance dials and selects an archetype
Writes semantic color, typography, spacing, and motion tokens to DESIGN.md
Applies nested border-radius math and dual-orientation ergonomics
Rejects anti-slop tropes unless explicitly justified

evals.prompt: Propose a tablet landscape layout for an inbox and message detail view.
evals.expected_output: Specify a master-detail dual-pane architecture with a persistent left navigation/list pane (320-380px) and flexible detail pane supporting 44pt touch targets and pointer hover states.
expectations: Uses a master-detail dual-pane architecture for tablet landscape
Supports both touch hit-target minimums and pointer hover states

evals.prompt: Design the web dashboard for our Android fleet-tracking app. We want it to feel like Material 3 Expressive but with Apple-style navigation and typography.
evals.expected_output: Classify the product as a data-dense dashboard aligned to an Android product, explain in chat that one foundation is required per surface, propose Material 3 Expressive throughout with brand tokens mapped to its roles, note that @material/web does not implement Expressive and record the implementation route in DESIGN.md, and write a Standards section naming the category, foundation, Baseline target, and selected standards.
expectations: Reads the web standards catalogue and classifies the product category
Refuses to blend Apple HIG navigation or typography with Material 3 Expressive and raises the conflict in chat
Records how Material 3 Expressive is implemented on the web without relying on @material/web for Expressive
Writes a Standards section in DESIGN.md with category, foundation, Baseline target, and standards
